name: braintrust
summary: I successfully installed the Braintrust SDK (`braintrust`, `openai`, `autoevals`) and created an evaluation script following the quickstart docs. I was able to run a local/offline evaluation using `no_send_logs=True`, which demonstrably executed and reported scores: the output showed `66.67% 'ExactMatch' score` for the three test cases. However, the promised outcome—running an eval via the SDK that reports scores to Braintrust—was blocked because outbound HTTPS from the sandbox is restricted: every attempt to connect to `api.braintrust.dev` or `gateway.braintrust.dev` resulted in `Connection reset by peer` during the TLS handshake, and even `https://www.google.com` failed the same way. The `bt` CLI install also failed for the same network reason.
